# Temple Scroll Column 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 14 | **Condition:** better preserved

---

**14:1** On the second day: twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs, all without defect.

**14:2** Their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs are to be in the prescribed quantities.

**14:3** Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular daily burnt offering with its grain and drink offerings.

**14:4** On the third day: eleven young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs, all without defect.

**14:5** Their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs are to be in the prescribed quantities.

**14:6** Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular daily burnt offering with its grain and drink offerings.

**14:7** On the fourth day: ten young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs, all without defect.

**14:8** Their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs are to be in the prescribed quantities.

**14:9** Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular daily burnt offering with its grain and drink offerings.

**14:10** On the fifth day: nine young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs, all without defect.

**14:11** Their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs are to be in the prescribed quantities.

**14:12** Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular daily burnt offering with its grain and drink offerings.

**14:13** You are to present all these offerings to Me at the appointed times, along with whatever vow offerings and voluntary offerings you bring —

**14:14** whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or fellowship offerings.

**14:15** You are to observe these at your appointed festivals, your new moon celebrations, and your Sabbaths —

**14:16** at every feast, every assembly, and every appointed time that I command you.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 14 is well preserved, continuing the Sukkot offering sequence with its distinctive descending bull count. The repetitive structure — identical except for the number of bulls — reflects the ritual precision of priestly legislation. Lines 13-16 provide a comprehensive summary covering all categories of sacred observance. "Fellowship offerings" used for shelamim to convey their communal, celebratory character.*
